title: 새옹지마 塞翁之馬
titleEn: The old man at the border and his horse

panels.en: An old man's horse ran away.

panels.ko: 그런데 말이 더 좋은 말을 데리고 돌아왔어요!
panels.en: But it came back with a better horse!

panels.ko: 그 말을 타던 아들이 떨어져 다리를 다쳤어요.
panels.en: His son fell off it and hurt his leg.

panels.ko: 그래서 아들은 전쟁에 나가지 않아도 됐어요.
panels.en: So the son didn't have to go to war.

meaning: 좋은 일과 나쁜 일은 미리 알 수 없어요
meaningEn: You never know what's good luck or bad luck
